widgets.action.mark_unwatched.description: Action verb shared by the media context menu and detail-page controls.

widgets.action.mark_watched.description: Action verb shared by the media context menu and detail-page controls.

widgets.action.play_start.description: Action verb shared by the media context menu and detail-page controls.

widgets.action.play_trailer.description: Action verb shared by the media context menu and detail-page controls.

widgets.badge.ad.description: Badge: the title has an audio-description track. Must match the abbreviation in browse.detail.audio_description (es: audiodescripción, AD).

widgets.badge.cc.description: Badge: the title has closed captions. The mark the explanation text browse.detail.closed_captions defines; keep the two in step. Latin CC is the international mark in Spain and in the be catalog's own explanation.

widgets.badge.forced.description: Compact media-track badge. This describes a subtitle or audio track.

widgets.badge.sdh.description: Badge: subtitles for the deaf and hard of hearing. Must match the abbreviation in browse.detail.sdh, which introduces it.

widgets.card.episode.description: Secondary caption beneath a focused media card.

widgets.card.new_episode.description: Secondary caption beneath a focused media card.

widgets.card.season_episode.description: Secondary caption beneath a focused media card.

widgets.card.show_new_episode.description: Secondary caption beneath a focused media card.

widgets.cards.more_failed.description: The tile at the end of a row of posters whose next page failed to load (first line).

widgets.cards.see_all.description: The tile at the end of a row of cards (and the last row of a row shown as a list) that opens the whole row. Must fit one line on a poster card at BODY size in every shipped language.

widgets.cards.try_again.description: The tile at the end of a row of posters whose next page failed: the action line under the reason; OK asks again.

widgets.failure.audio_unsupported.value: Playback failed — this TV cannot decode the audio track
widgets.failure.audio_unsupported.description: Player error caption: the selected audio track's format (or channel count) has no decoder on this TV and the app has no software decoder for it yet.

widgets.failure.dolby_vision.value: Playback failed — this Dolby Vision stream cannot be shown correctly here
widgets.failure.dolby_vision.description: Player error caption: a Dolby Vision stream whose base layer alone is a wrong picture, on a TV that cannot be told it is Dolby Vision.

widgets.failure.jail.value: Playback failed — this TV's sandbox blocks native video

widgets.failure.load_timeout.value: Playback failed — the TV did not finish starting the stream

widgets.failure.no_video.value: Playback failed — no video in the file
widgets.failure.no_video.description: Player error caption or supporting subscription fact.

widgets.failure.not_video_archive.value: This stream is an archive (ZIP/RAR), not a video
widgets.failure.not_video_archive.description: Player error caption: the stream link answered a ZIP or RAR archive instead of the video. Keep ZIP/RAR untranslated.

widgets.failure.not_video_document.value: This stream is a text file, not a video
widgets.failure.not_video_document.description: Player error caption: the stream link answered a text file (JSON, plain text, a subtitle or .nfo) instead of the video.

widgets.failure.not_video_image.value: This stream is an image, not a video
widgets.failure.not_video_image.description: Player error caption: the stream link answered an image (PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP) instead of the video — the addon picked the wrong file in a torrent.

widgets.failure.open.value: Playback failed — the media stream could not be opened
widgets.failure.open.description: Player error caption or supporting subscription fact.

widgets.failure.stopped.value: Playback failed — playback stopped after starting
widgets.failure.stopped.description: Player error caption or supporting subscription fact.

widgets.failure.tv_rejected.value: Playback failed — the TV rejected the stream
widgets.failure.tv_rejected.description: Player error caption or supporting subscription fact.

widgets.failure.video_not_streamable.value: Playback failed — this video format cannot be streamed on this TV
widgets.failure.video_not_streamable.description: Player error caption: the stream's video codec (MPEG-4 Part 2/Xvid/DivX, MPEG-2, H.263, VC-1/WMV, RealVideo) is one the TV's streaming player cannot be fed, though the TV's own file player may know it.

widgets.failure.video_unsupported.value: Playback failed — this TV cannot decode the video
widgets.failure.video_unsupported.description: Player error caption: the stream's video codec has no decoder on this TV.

widgets.failure.web_page.value: The service answered with a web page instead of the video
widgets.failure.web_page.description: Player error caption: the streaming (debrid) service answered with an HTML web page instead of the video file, even after retrying.

widgets.hint.hold_options.description: Complete sentence in the Home screen's standing hint capsule, teaching that holding the remote's OK button on a card opens its context menu. {key} is the OK button rendered as a keycap; keep exactly one occurrence. Must fit one line in the capsule at CAPTION size in every shipped language.

widgets.panel.audio_unsupported.value: the TV has no decoder for the audio track
widgets.panel.audio_unsupported.description: Diagnostics panel verdict suffix: the audio track cannot be decoded by the TV.

widgets.panel.dolby_vision.value: Dolby Vision stream with no displayable base layer
widgets.panel.dolby_vision.description: Diagnostics panel verdict suffix: a Dolby Vision stream refused because its base layer is not a correct picture.

widgets.panel.jail.value: this install's sandbox blocks access to /dev/rtkmem; a repair needs rooted Homebrew Channel access

widgets.panel.load_timeout.value: the television media pipeline did not finish starting the stream in time

widgets.panel.no_video.value: the stream carries no video track
widgets.panel.no_video.description: Player diagnostic reason; preserve technical device paths and protocol endpoints.

widgets.panel.not_video_archive.value: the stream is an archive, not a video
widgets.panel.not_video_archive.description: Diagnostics panel verdict suffix: the stream is an archive, not a video.

widgets.panel.not_video_document.value: the stream is a text file, not a video
widgets.panel.not_video_document.description: Diagnostics panel verdict suffix: the stream is a text file, not a video.

widgets.panel.not_video_image.value: the stream is an image, not a video
widgets.panel.not_video_image.description: Diagnostics panel verdict suffix: the stream is an image, not a video.

widgets.panel.open.value: the media stream could not be opened or read
widgets.panel.open.description: Player diagnostic reason; preserve technical device paths and protocol endpoints.

widgets.panel.stopped.value: the media producer stopped before playback completed
widgets.panel.stopped.description: Player diagnostic reason; preserve technical device paths and protocol endpoints.

widgets.panel.tv_rejected.value: the television media pipeline rejected the stream
widgets.panel.tv_rejected.description: Player diagnostic reason; preserve technical device paths and protocol endpoints.

widgets.panel.unknown.value: the player stopped without a reported cause
widgets.panel.unknown.description: Player diagnostic reason; preserve technical device paths and protocol endpoints.

widgets.panel.video_not_streamable.value: the TV's streaming player cannot take this video format
widgets.panel.video_not_streamable.description: Diagnostics panel verdict suffix: the video codec cannot be fed to the TV's streaming player.

widgets.panel.video_unsupported.value: the TV has no decoder for the video
widgets.panel.video_unsupported.description: Diagnostics panel verdict suffix: the video codec cannot be decoded by the TV.

widgets.panel.web_page.value: the service answered with a web page
widgets.panel.web_page.description: Diagnostics panel verdict suffix: the service answered a web page instead of the video.

widgets.reason.audio_unsupported.value: This TV has no decoder for this audio track; choose another audio track or stream
widgets.reason.audio_unsupported.description: Explanation beneath the playback-failed heading when the audio track cannot be decoded by the TV.

widgets.reason.dolby_vision.value: This Dolby Vision stream has no picture this TV can show without Dolby Vision; choose another stream
widgets.reason.dolby_vision.description: Explanation beneath the playback-failed heading for a Dolby Vision stream that cannot be shown correctly.

widgets.reason.jail.value: This set's sandbox does not give the app /dev/rtkmem

widgets.reason.jail_help.value: Repair needs a rooted TV with Homebrew Channel.

widgets.reason.load_timeout.value: This TV did not finish starting the video stream in time

widgets.reason.no_video.value: This file has no video track
widgets.reason.no_video.description: Explanation beneath the playback-failed heading. Device paths and project identifiers stay unchanged.

widgets.reason.open.value: The media stream could not be opened
widgets.reason.open.description: Explanation beneath the playback-failed heading. Device paths and project identifiers stay unchanged.

widgets.reason.stopped.value: Playback stopped after it had started
widgets.reason.stopped.description: Explanation beneath the playback-failed heading. Device paths and project identifiers stay unchanged.

widgets.reason.tv_rejected.value: This TV could not start the video stream
widgets.reason.tv_rejected.description: Explanation beneath the playback-failed heading. Device paths and project identifiers stay unchanged.

widgets.reason.unknown.value: The player stopped before it could identify the problem
widgets.reason.unknown.description: Explanation beneath the playback-failed heading. Device paths and project identifiers stay unchanged.

widgets.reason.video_not_streamable.value: This TV streams H.264, HEVC, AV1, VP9 and VP8 video only — not Xvid/DivX, MPEG-2, H.263, VC-1/WMV or RealVideo; choose another stream
widgets.reason.video_not_streamable.description: Explanation beneath the playback-failed heading when the video codec is one the TV's streaming player cannot take. Keep the codec names untranslated.

widgets.reason.video_unsupported.value: This TV has no decoder for this video format; choose another stream
widgets.reason.video_unsupported.description: Explanation beneath the playback-failed heading when the video codec cannot be decoded by the TV.

widgets.reason.web_page.value: The service may still be preparing the file. Try again in a moment, or pick another stream.
widgets.reason.web_page.description: Explanation beneath the web-page heading: the debrid service may still be preparing the file; try again shortly or pick another stream.

widgets.reason.wrong_file.value: The addon picked the wrong file in this torrent. Try another release.
widgets.reason.wrong_file.description: Explanation beneath the not-a-video heading: the addon chose the wrong file from the torrent; the viewer should pick another release (another stream).
